description:
Key areas of competency:  
 Describe the TRIRIGA core platform tool set. 
 Use tools for developing the User Experience (Portal Sections, Navigation, and Security). 
 Tools for developing data model and business logic (Form Layout, State Actions). 
 Describe Report/Query techniques. 
 Apply business logic through use of workflows. 
 Describe how Security works. 
 Able to load data and/or metadata in to TRIRIGA using the various tools.
 Prerequisite Knowledge:  

 Basic knowledge of software development lifecycle 
 Basic knowledge of operating platform 
 Basic knowledge of the Admin Console 
 Basic knowledge of how the TRIRIGA Application Platform is implemented in a customer's environment
 Basic knowledge of relational databases 
 Basic knowledge of State Transition Families 
 Working knowledge of Form, Smart, Query, and Multi-tab sections 
 Basic knowledge of Synchronous and Asynchronous Workflows 
 Working knowledge of security 
 Working knowledge of the TRIRIGA Portfolio module 
 Working knowledge of the Object Migration Tool and its- limitations 
 Working knowledge of Portals and Portal Sections 
 Working Knowledge of Navigation Items and Collections 
 Working Knowledge of TRIRIGA reports and queries.
 

 Thankyou,
 Asma Khan Suri


 Additional Info:
 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
